prompt.context: repo-map is a zero-dependency Node CLI (bin/repo-map.mjs) that serves an interactive architecture map of a repo. lib/server.mjs is a localhost HTTP server for the single-file UI in app/index.html; lib/ai/ runs AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible APIs) read-only to draw the map and trace processes.
